# Load data
```{r } 
df_index <- readRDS("./data/dataset/MERLIN_cohort_index_cases_metadata_final.RDS") 
prolonged_colonization_df <- readRDS("./data/persistent_colonization/persistent_colonization_episodes/MERLIN_persistent_colonization_index_patients_public_references.RDS")
clinical_prolonged_colonization <- read_csv("./data/persistent_colonization/deprecated/old/merlin_prolonged_colonization.csv")
```
 
# Get number of positive households with index specimen sequenced
```{r}
ESCrE_index_positive_households <- df_index %>% subset(visit ==0 & WGS_escre==T) %>% .$household
paste0("Number of subjects with index specimens positive: ", length(ESCrE_index_positive_households))
paste0("Proportion of subjects with index specimens positive: ", length(ESCrE_index_positive_households) / 40)
```

# How many of the MALDI characterized species-level prolonged colonization had a QC-passing genome for their index genome?
```{r}
clinical_definition_prolonged <- clinical_prolonged_colonization %>% subset(prolonged_colonization==1) %>% .[["household_number"]]
paste0("How many of the prolonged colonization episodes we had their index sequenced: ", length(clinical_definition_prolonged))

paste0("How many of the clinical definition did we have qc-passing WGS escre genome?")
table(clinical_definition_prolonged %in% ESCrE_index_positive_households) 
```

# Data for the individuals w/ MALDI-level prolonged colonization with sequencing
```{r}
prolonged_melt <- reshape2::melt(prolonged_colonization_df %>% subset(household %in% clinical_definition_prolonged)  %>%  select(household,index_at_1_and_or_2_WGS_escre,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster,index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_aware,index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_linked),id.vars="household")
prolonged_melt$value <- factor(prolonged_melt$value,levels = c(0,1))
prolonged_melt$variable <- recode(prolonged_melt$variable,'index_at_1_and_or_2_WGS_escre'='Any ESCrE','index_at_1_and_or_2_Species'='Species','index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST'='Sequence type','index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster'='Strain','index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes'='ESCrE gene','index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_plasmidic_genes'= 'Plasmidic ESCrE gene','index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_plasmids'= 'ESCrE plasmid',
  'index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes'='Strain + ESCrE gene',
  'index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_aware'='Strain + plasmid-aware ESCrE gene',
  'index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_linked'='Strain + plasmid-linked ESCrE gene')

prolonged_melt %>% mutate(value = (value ==1)) %>% group_by(variable) %>% summarise(n=sum(value),prop=n/length(value)) %>% favorite_kable()
```

# Persistence data by SNP threshold
```{r}
persistent_colonization_by_threshold <- readRDS("./data/persistent_colonization/threshold_sensitivity_strain_level/MERLIN_persistent_colonization_threshold_sensitivity_strain_level_public_references.RDS")

household_w_index <- df_index %>% subset(visit==0) %>% .$household %>% sort

prolonged_df <- persistent_colonization_by_threshold %>% group_by(threshold) %>% summarise(num_prolonged = sum(index_at_1_and_or_2))
 
ref <- 18

runs <- prolonged_df %>%
  arrange(threshold) %>%
  mutate(run = consecutive_id(num_prolonged))

run_ref <- runs$run[runs$threshold == ref]

plateau <- runs %>%
  filter(run == run_ref) %>%
  summarise(
    num_prolonged = first(num_prolonged),
    min_threshold = min(threshold),
    max_threshold = max(threshold),
    n_thresholds  = n()
  )

plateau

runs %>% subset(threshold %in% c(18,plateau$max_threshold,plateau$max_threshold+1))
```

# Clustering pattern similarity
```{r}
clustering_across_thresholds_ST_preferred <- readRDS("./data/SNP_distances/SNP_cluster_assignments/MERLIN_SNP_cluster_assignments_public_references.RDS")

similarity_dataset_index <- lapply(0:100, FUN = function(x) {
    ref_col <- "Species_ST_cluster_18"
    col_name <- paste0("Species_ST_cluster_", x)
    
    SNP_clustering <- clustering_across_thresholds_ST_preferred %>%
        select(genomic_id, all_of(ref_col), all_of(col_name)) %>%
        subset(genomic_id %in% df_index$genomic_id)
    
    ref_clusters <- SNP_clustering[[ref_col]]
    threshold_clusters <- SNP_clustering[[col_name]]
    
    co_cluster_ref <- outer(ref_clusters, ref_clusters, "==")
    co_cluster_threshold <- outer(threshold_clusters, threshold_clusters, "==")
    pair_concordance <- mean((co_cluster_ref == co_cluster_threshold)[lower.tri(co_cluster_ref)])
    
    data.frame(
        threshold            = x,
        ARI                  = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(ref_clusters, threshold_clusters),
        pairwise_concordance = pair_concordance,
        isolates             = nrow(SNP_clustering)
    )
}) %>%
    bind_rows()


get_plateau <- function(df, metric, ref, digits = 10) {
  runs <- df %>%
    arrange(threshold) %>%
    mutate(run = consecutive_id(round(.data[[metric]], digits)))

  run_ref <- runs$run[runs$threshold == ref]

  runs %>%
    filter(run == run_ref) %>%
    summarise(
      metric        = metric,
      value         = first(.data[[metric]]),
      min_threshold = min(threshold),
      max_threshold = max(threshold),
      n_thresholds  = n()
    )
}

plateaus <- bind_rows(
  get_plateau(similarity_dataset_index, "ARI", ref),
  get_plateau(similarity_dataset_index, "pairwise_concordance", ref)
)

plateaus

# Rows at the reference, each plateau edge, and the first threshold past each edge
edges <- unique(c(plateaus$min_threshold - 1, ref,
                  plateaus$max_threshold, plateaus$max_threshold + 1))

similarity_dataset_index %>%
  filter(threshold %in% edges) %>%
  arrange(threshold)
```
